decision_description: Constitutional violation §13.3 detected during compliance check of docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json. The artifact's partner_coverage_results entry for HOST names 'ELTE' (Eötvös Loránd University) as a specific partner institution — a concrete project fact — without providing a traceability_footer with primary_sources[] referencing any path within docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/. Per CLAUDE.md §13.3, project-fact claims naming specific partners by institutional identity must be traceable to Tier 3 source documents. The artifact carries no such traceability anchor, meaning the institutional reference 'ELTE' is asserted without a documented Tier 3 source within the artifact itself. This constitutes a §13.3 violation. Resolution requires: (a) amending the artifact to include a traceability_footer with primary_sources[] pointing to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json (which records partner_id HOST, legal_name: Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE), Budapest, beneficiary: true), or (b) human operator confirmation that the reference is derivable from already-written Tier 4 state and a documented resolution ruling. This skill does not resolve constitutional violations; it records them as unresolved.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §13.3 — prohibition on inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3; the artifact must supply a primary_sources[] reference pointing to docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json to ground the institutional identity claim 'ELTE' in a named Tier 3 source
rationale: The compliance validator skill checked the budget_gate_assessment.json artifact against CLAUDE.md §13 prohibitions. The partner_coverage_results entry for HOST names 'ELTE' as the sole beneficiary institution — a project-specific fact. The artifact contains no traceability_footer field and therefore provides no named Tier 3 source reference for this claim. CLAUDE.md §13.3 prohibits project facts that are not traceable to Tier 3. The corresponding Tier 3 artifact (docs/tier3_project_instantiation/consortium/partners.json) does establish ELTE as the HOST institution, but that traceability link is absent from the audited artifact. Until the artifact is amended or the operator provides a documented resolution ruling, the violation is unresolved and the decision log entry must record it as such per CLAUDE.md §9.4 and §12.3.
